description: Explains what a Verilog module does, in plain English: its inputs and outputs, its behaviour and anything unusual. Use this when the person pastes Verilog and asks "what does this do?" or wants FPGA code someone else wrote explained. Returns the explanation as text; nothing is built or changed. Counts toward the daily design limit.

code.description: The Verilog source code, one or more modules (at most 20,000 characters).

name: explain_chip
title: Explain Verilog
